<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <PackageId>Aspose.Email.Foss</PackageId>
    <Version>0.1.0</Version>
    <Authors>Aspose.Email FOSS Contributors</Authors>
    <Description>Dependency-free C# toolkit for CFB, MSG, and EML workflows generated and implemented from the repository knowledgebase.</Description>
    <PackageTags>aspose;email;msg;cfb;eml;mapi</PackageTags>
    <PackageLicenseExpression>MIT</PackageLicenseExpression>
    <RepositoryUrl>https://github.com/aspose-email-foss/Aspose.Email-FOSS-for-.NET</RepositoryUrl>
    <RepositoryType>git</RepositoryType>
    <PackageReadmeFile>README.md</PackageReadmeFile>
    <PublishRepositoryUrl>true</PublishRepositoryUrl>
    <IncludeSymbols>true</IncludeSymbols>
    <SymbolPackageFormat>snupkg</SymbolPackageFormat>
    <AssemblyName>Aspose.Email.Foss</AssemblyName>
    <RootNamespace>Aspose.Email.Foss</RootNamespace>
    <IsPackable>true</IsPackable>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <None Include="..\..\README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="\" Link="README.md" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
